name: Fisher-Price Deluxe Kick & Play Piano Gym
description: 5-in-1 baby gym grows with your baby from lying to sitting. Includes a removable piano keyboard babies can kick or play with hands, 4 light-up piano keys with music and sounds, plus a soft mat with colorful toys overhead.
safety_notes: No loose parts. Machine washable mat. Meets all ASTM safety standards. Suitable from birth.
why_great: Encourages tummy time with high-contrast overhead toys, develops motor skills through kicking the piano, and transitions with baby through sitting stage.

name: Infantino Twist & Fold Activity Gym & Play Mat
description: Fold-flat design for easy storage. Features 20+ activities, 40+ songs and sounds, a removable toy bar, and a reversible mat for tummy time and back play. High-contrast black-and-white patterns stimulate newborn vision.
safety_notes: All toys are securely attached. Foldable frame locks in place when open. BPA-free materials.
why_great: High-contrast patterns are perfect for newborn vision development (0-3 months). Tummy time mode provides bolster support for babies who resist tummy time.

name: Infantino Go gaga! Tummy Time & Seated Support Pillow
description: Crescent-shaped pillow provides gentle chest support during tummy time, reducing the effort needed and making tummy time more comfortable and enjoyable. Wipeable, water-resistant cover.
safety_notes: Never leave baby unattended on tummy time pillow. Always supervise tummy time. Not for sleeping.
why_great: Babies who resist tummy time often do so because it's tiring — this pillow reduces strain so they can enjoy it longer, building the neck and core strength needed for sitting and crawling.

name: BABYBJÖRN Bouncer Balance Soft
description: Award-winning bouncer that moves with baby's own movements. Three recline positions: newborn rest, active play, and sitting. No batteries needed — gentle rocking is powered by baby's own movement.
safety_notes: 5-point safety harness. OEKO-TEX certified fabric (free from harmful substances). Always use on floor, never elevated surfaces. Do not use as sleeping device.
why_great: The self-bouncing motion soothes fussy babies and gives parents hands-free moments. The upright position aids digestion for gassy or colicky babies.

name: Graco Sense2Soothe Baby Swing with Cry Detection
description: Detects and responds to baby's cries automatically. Adjusts swing speed and sound to soothe. 6 swing speeds, 15 songs, and nature sounds. Converts to a rocker when detached from base.
safety_notes: Max weight 13.6kg. Recline for newborns under 4 months. Always use 3-point harness. Not for sleeping.
why_great: Cry detection technology provides consistent soothing — ideal for overtired or colicky newborns when parents need their hands free.

name: Philips Avent Natural Baby Bottle Newborn Starter Set
description: Starter set includes 2×125ml and 2×260ml Natural bottles, a soother, and a bottle brush. Natural teat shape supports breastfeeding. Anti-colic valve reduces air ingestion.
safety_notes: BPA-free. Compatible with Philips Avent sterilisers. Replace teats every 3 months or if damaged.
why_great: The wide breast-shaped teat allows natural latch, making it easier to switch between breast and bottle — great for breastfeeding mums introducing a bottle.

name: Haakaa Gen 3 Silicone Breast Pump
description: Hands-free silicone pump that uses gentle suction to collect letdown milk from the opposite breast while nursing. No cords, no batteries, no assembly. 160ml capacity.
safety_notes: Food-grade silicone, BPA/BPS/PVC-free. Sterilise before first use. Inspect for tears before each use.
why_great: Captures milk that would otherwise be wasted during letdown — many mums collect 1-2oz per feed effortlessly, building a freezer stash without a dedicated pumping session.

name: Chicco Pocket Snack Booster Seat
description: Portable booster seat clips to any dining chair. 3 height positions, removable and dishwasher-safe tray with cup holder. Folds flat for travel. Max weight 15kg.
safety_notes: Only attach to chairs without armrests and with seat backs. Always secure safety belt. Adult supervision required.
why_great: Perfect when starting solids at 6 months — keeps baby at table height with family, supporting feeding development and social eating habits.

name: STOKKE Tripp Trapp High Chair
description: Iconic adjustable chair that grows with your child from 6 months to adulthood. Seat and footrest adjust to 7 positions each. Natural beech wood. Add Baby Set (sold separately) for babies 6–36 months.
safety_notes: Ensure all bolts are tightened before each use. Baby Set required for children under 3. Max weight 136kg for adult use.
why_great: Ergonomic seat position supports upright posture during meals — helps babies who are starting solids develop self-feeding skills with both feet firmly supported.

name: Manhattan Toy Winkel Rattle & Sensory Teether
description: A maze of soft, interlocking tubes that are easy for small hands to grip. Rattle beads inside create gentle sound. All surfaces are safe for mouthing and teething.
safety_notes: BPA-free. No small parts. Wipe clean with soap and water. Inspect regularly for cracks.
why_great: The looped shape is perfect for babies learning to grasp (3–6 months) — any angle offers a grippable surface. The rattle causes-and-effect learning while gentle enough for sore gums.

name: Sophie la Girafe Teether
description: The iconic French teether made from 100% natural rubber and food-safe paint. Squeaks when squeezed. High-contrast black and white spots stimulate baby vision. Different parts of Sophie soothe different areas of baby's gums.
safety_notes: Natural rubber — do not submerge in water as interior may mould. Wipe exterior with damp cloth only. Check for cracks regularly.
why_great: Different body parts reach different parts of baby's mouth — the nose soothes front teeth, the legs reach molars. The squeak provides instant cause-and-effect feedback.

name: Lamaze Freddie the Firefly Clip & Go
description: Bright multi-sensory toy clips to pram, car seat, or activity gym. Features crinkle wings, teething ring, rattle, squeaker, and mirror. High-contrast colours stimulate developing vision.
safety_notes: Machine washable. Clip tested to European safety standards. No small parts. Regularly check clip security.
why_great: Stimulates all five senses — crinkle sounds, squeaker, textures, a mirror for self-recognition, and bright colours — without overwhelming baby. Perfect from birth.

name: Melissa & Doug 12-Piece Wooden Stacking Blocks
description: 12 solid hardwood blocks in 3 shapes and 6 colours. Includes a stackable storage bucket. Nesting, stacking, sorting, and colour-matching encourage creative play.
safety_notes: Non-toxic paints. Tested to ASTM & CE safety standards. No sharp edges. Supervise children under 3 for choking risk assessment.
why_great: Stacking and knocking down develops spatial reasoning, fine motor control, and cause-and-effect understanding — hitting the key 12–18 month developmental window.

name: VTech Sit-to-Stand Learning Walker
description: Push walker with adjustable speed resistance to support confident first steps. Detachable activity panel works as a standalone play centre. Features alphabet, numbers, colours, animals, and music.
safety_notes: Adjustable resistance wheels — set resistance high for new walkers. Use on flat surfaces only. Not suitable as a stair-gate substitute.
why_great: The adjustable wheel resistance is key — too fast and baby falls, too slow and they lose interest. Start on highest resistance when baby first pulls to stand (~9 months).

name: LEGO DUPLO Classic Brick Box (85 pieces)
description: 85 DUPLO bricks in 9 colours including basic bricks, special pieces and a number brick. Storage box doubles as a building plate. Introduces early building and creative play.
safety_notes: DUPLO bricks are oversized — specifically designed to be non-choking-hazard safe for toddlers. Not compatible with standard LEGO for safety reasons.
why_great: DUPLO at 18 months builds vocabulary (colours, shapes), fine motor pinch grip, and early engineering thinking. The box-as-baseplate encourages tidying up as part of play.

name: Ergobaby Omni 360 Baby Carrier
description: All-position carrier: front-inward, front-outward, hip, and back carry. No infant insert needed from birth. Padded lumbar support for parent. Machine washable.
safety_notes: Hip-healthy design certified by International Hip Dysplasia Institute. Always follow TICKS rule (Tight, In view, Close enough to kiss, Keep chin off chest, Supported back). Face-out carry from 5 months only.
why_great: Close contact with parent's heartbeat and warmth is proven to calm fussy or colicky babies. Hands-free carrying supports breastfeeding on the go.

name: Angelcare AC527 Baby Monitor with Movement Sensor Pad
description: Video, sound, and movement monitoring in one. Sensor pad under mattress detects breathing movements and sounds an alarm if no movement detected for 20 seconds. 1080p HD video.
safety_notes: Alarm triggers if no movement sensed for 20 seconds — do not rely solely on alarm for infant safety. Continue following safe sleep guidelines (back to sleep, firm mattress, no loose bedding).
why_great: Provides extra peace of mind for parents of newborns — especially for those with premature babies or a family history of SIDS. The video function also reduces unnecessary check-ins that disturb sleep.

name: Munchkin 360 Miracle Trainer Cup
description: Drink from any edge — 360-degree rim works like a real cup but is completely spill-proof when closed. No spout means normal muscle movement and supports oral development. Dishwasher safe.
safety_notes: BPA-free. Inspect seal before each use. Suitable for water and milk — not for hot liquids.
why_great: Drinking from all edges means baby doesn't need to tilt head back, supporting natural swallowing and preventing tooth decay often associated with traditional spouted cups.

name: Summer Infant SwaddleMe Original Swaddle 3-Pack
description: Pre-shaped swaddle with hook-and-loop fastening — no origami folding required. Soft cotton-blend fabric. Wing design prevents swaddle from loosening. Pack of 3.
safety_notes: Stop swaddling as soon as baby shows signs of rolling (usually 2-4 months). Always place swaddled baby on back. Ensure hips have room to flex — tight hip swaddling risks dysplasia.
why_great: The Moro (startle) reflex wakes newborns frequently — swaddling mimics the womb and suppresses this reflex, helping babies sleep longer stretches. The hook-and-loop design stays secure even for strong babies.

name: Sleepyhead Deluxe+ Baby Pod
description: Ergonomic pod with gentle bumpers that creates a snug, womb-like environment. Ventilated insert. Portable for use around the home. Removable, machine-washable cover.
safety_notes: NOT for unsupervised sleep. Always use on flat surface at ground level. Never on sofas, beds, or elevated surfaces. Baby should always be in your sight while in the pod.
why_great: The snug bumpers create the womb-like environment that soothes newborns during awake lounging time. Helps with transitions — useful for setting baby down between feeds during supervised time.

name: Nuby 3-Stage Teething Toy Set
description: Set of 3 teethers designed for each teething stage: soft silicone for first teeth (3m+), textured for front teeth (6m+), and firm for molars (12m+). All feature different shapes and textures.
safety_notes: BPA, PVC, and phthalate-free. Do not freeze gel-filled teethers as they can crack. Inspect before each use.
why_great: Teething typically begins around 4-6 months — having the right texture for each stage is key. Softer for early gum tenderness, firmer for molar discomfort later.

name: Skip Hop Explore & More 3-Stage Activity Centre
description: Three-in-one: floor gym (3m+), activity seat (6m+), and toddler table (12m+). 25+ ways to play. Light-up piano, spinning globe, clicking gears, peek-a-boo doors. 360° rotating seat.
safety_notes: Exersaucer use should be limited to 20–30 minutes per day — too much time in a static supported position can delay independent movement. Always ensure base is on flat floor.
why_great: The rotating seat builds core stability while babies push off to turn, preparing them for sitting. The transition from floor gym to table with a simple adjustment saves buying multiple products.

name: Chicco Jumper Balloon Doorway Bouncer
description: Attaches to any doorframe with no tools. 360° rotating seat. Adjustable height (3 positions). Detachable toy bar with rattles and teether. Supports babies up to 12kg.
safety_notes: Check doorframe suitability before use. Always supervise baby. Limit use to 20 minutes per session — too much bouncer time reduces floor play opportunities. Not suitable if baby cannot hold head steady.
why_great: At 5-6 months when babies are desperate to be upright but can't stand yet, a doorway jumper burns energy and strengthens leg muscles — often calming a fussy baby who's bored of lying down.

name: Babymoov Cosydream+ Newborn Lounger
description: Inclined 15° wedge design to ease discomfort from colic and reflux. Soft cocoon sides for security. Removable cover, machine washable.
safety_notes: Supervised use only. Not for sleeping. The 15° incline is for supervised lounging after feeds. Always keep baby in eyesight.
why_great: The 15° incline relieves pressure on babies with reflux during supervised awake time, particularly useful in the first 3 months when reflux is most common.

name: Melissa & Doug Shape Sorting Cube
description: Classic wooden shape sorter with 6 shape-matching doors and 25 colourful solid wood shapes. Removable lid for easy shape retrieval. Promotes cognitive development and problem-solving.
safety_notes: Non-toxic paint. Shapes are large enough not to be a choking hazard. Splinter-free smooth wood. Supervise children under 3.
why_great: Shape sorting is a key 12–18 month milestone — it builds hand-eye coordination, shape recognition, and the persistence of trial-and-error learning. The 6 doors add variety to keep toddlers engaged longer.
